_note: Fifth monster (docs/ART-REDO.md), the ogre (sim kind troll). The concept crop is the ogre in monsters.jpg (the registry crop 524,292,226,286, widened to 526,292,768,580 so the club head is not cut); it shows the skeleton's shield at its left edge and a wolf's head at its right, so the views draw one ogre and nothing else. MARKS tusks and club. World height 34 is monsterHeights.troll; at the hero texel (32/88) that is 94 px, head to feet, under 1.75 keep doors. The club hangs at his side in the views, so the 94 px is the ogre itself. The cell is 160, not 110 (94 + 16): the slam lifts the club high over his head, about 50 px above it, and dead on his side he is about as long as he is tall, with the club beside him. The clips start from the skeleton, wolf and bat precheck lessons: every motion stays on the spot, the slam lands in front of him without a step, and the death holds the start pose for a moment and only moves down. The club is in his left hand (image-right in the front view), as the concept holds it, and is a MARK, so it is "visible": no view may hide it behind the body (the goblin's first view-E lost its spear). view-E came out facing screen-left twice (the second take also with a broken leg and a loose foot): 'right side toward the camera' fought 'club in his left hand, in full view', because in a right profile the left hand is on the far side. The item's sides.E now says where the far hand holds it (forward past his belly, the club head in front of him on the image-right side) and view_notes.E pins the facing: face and tusks to the right edge, the mirror of view-W.
source_note: the reference shows one ogre with parts of other monsters at its edges; draw only the ogre with his spiked club and nothing else, no shield, no wolf
design: huge hulking ogre with mossy green blocky skin, a heavy brow, small pointed ears, glowing orange-red eyes, a wide underbite jaw with two big upward tusks and yellowed teeth, a dark brown leather strap across his bare chest, a brown leather belt with a bone skull buckle over a ragged brown hide loincloth, brown leather bracers on his forearms and wraps on his shins, and big bare green feet
gait: Slow heavy ogre stomp on the spot: knees bent, legs alternating clearly, big shoulders swaying, slight body bob; his body never moves forward

items.name: huge dark brown wooden club studded with grey iron spikes
items.walk: club hanging low at his side in his left hand, its spiked head near the ground

sides.E: his far hand, held forward past his belly so the spiked head of the club shows in front of him on the image-right side

attack: plants his feet, raises the club high over his head with both hands, then slams it straight down onto the ground just in front of him in the facing direction, then lifts it back; his feet stay planted on the same spot, he does not step or jump
death: roars and holds the exact first-frame pose still for a moment, then drops the club, sinks to his knees and topples over onto his side on the exact spot where he stood, the club lying beside him. His body only ever moves down, never up. He does not leap, spin or fall forward toward the camera; he lies where his feet were

turntable.design: huge hulking ogre with mossy green blocky skin, a heavy brow, small pointed ears, glowing orange-red eyes, a wide underbite jaw with two big upward tusks, a dark brown leather strap across his bare chest, a brown leather belt with a bone skull buckle over a ragged brown hide loincloth, brown leather bracers and shin wraps, big bare green feet, a huge spiked wooden club hanging low at his side in his left hand

view_notes.E: He faces screen-right: his face, tusks and nose point to the right edge of the image and his back is toward the left edge, the mirror image of the left profile view, not the same view; his right arm and right leg are nearest the camera and both legs are whole, each foot joined to its leg and standing on the ground

check._note: anchors: concept colours (hero_sprites.py troll colours) the palette keeps within dE 15: the mossy green skin, its dark and its lit tone, the dark brown leather, the warm hide, the bone of the skull buckle and tusks, and the orange eye. roles, tuned on the take-1 trial sheet (all 20 clips): the ogre's colours are dull, half of them greys (chroma under 0.12), and they split by hue: green skin 45-70, brown leather and hide 15-45. pale is the light warm colours (hue 20-40, light over 0.28, not grey): the bone skull buckle, tusks and teeth, the eyes and the lit hide loincloth, all on his front. spike is the light grey of the club's iron spikes and the teeth. prop: null. The club is the same dark brown as the leather, and its grey spikes are under 6 px in NW, NE and E and in S and SW attack frames (the club over his head), so no colour follows the club in every frame. bounds: the skeleton's 0.64 x start pose floor fails the front's own slam (S start pose 237 pale px, the crouched slam 113, the club over his head 155). Instead the back's ceiling is 0.2 x the S start pose (48; N frames 16-47) and the front's floor twice that (96; S frames 113-283), so a front column turned away and a back column turned to the camera both fail.

back.title: back view N shows little of the pale front

front.title: front view S keeps the pale buckle, tusks and hide

clip_overrides._note: Take 2 (take 1 kept in /workspace/lk/troll-take1, with its precheck log). Take 1 passed every clip check but four sheet checks, on the 160 px cell with foot line 153: walk-NW stood 89 px in one frame (94 +-4: a crouch in the stomp); death-S had not finished falling when the clip ended (last frame 70 px tall, limit 60% of 94 = 56; still on hands and knees at frame 47), sank 4-6 px under the foot line (falling toward the camera; limit 3) and its club rolled out to the cell's bottom edge; death-W and death-E rose 4 px off the line while kneeling (moving away from the camera) and death-W ended 5 px under it. So walk-NW stomps at full height without crouching, death-S falls fast and sideways, lying flat for the last second with the club against his body, and the side deaths fall forward along the ground line and never toward or away from the camera. Take 3 (take 2 kept in /workspace/lk/troll-take2, with its log and trial sheet): death-S now falls in time (ends 157 px low, flat) and its club stays in the cell, but every lying end sits under the foot line: death-S and death-W end 4 px under it and death-E 5 px (limit 3), and death-E kneels 5 px over it. Root cause: a 94 px ogre lying on his side or front is deep, and the near side of a body lying on the ground shows lower in the frame than the line his feet stood on; the wolf, half his size, stayed within 3 px. So the deaths keep his feet where they stood and topple him away from the camera, his body lying behind his feet. walk-NW was 89 px again: the 'full standing height' gait still walked with his back hunched forward, so the gait names an upright back, chest up and head level. Take 4 (take 3 kept in /workspace/lk/troll-take3, with its trial sheet in /workspace/lk/trollprep/troll3.png): death-W passes. death-E dropped the club and stumbled, its feet 4 px off the line mid-fall (149, limit 3), so it ends on death-W's flipped last frame (death_ends, the wolf's fix) and keeps its feet down until he lies. death-S fell backward as asked but ended propped on his elbows, 62 px tall (at most 56), and the club fell in front of his feet to the cell's bottom edge, so the club falls behind him on the image-right side and he ends flat on his back, arms along his sides. walk-NW dips to 89 px in two stride frames on its third take, with an upright back: the stride itself dips, so the gait now says his head stays at one height with no bob. Motion-spaced death picks were tried on take 3 and made it worse (rows 148..159), so the troll keeps time picks. Take 5 (take 4 kept in /workspace/lk/troll-take4, with its precheck log and trial sheet troll4.png): death-E passes, ending on death-W's flipped end. death-S fell backward and ended sitting up, 74 px tall (take 3: 62, propped; limit 56), and as he went down his legs slid toward the camera to the cell's bottom edge (159). A backward fall seen from the front has now ended propped or sitting on two takes, so take 5 goes back to take 2's sideways fall (flat and in time, 4 px under the line): across the frame toward the image-left edge, rolling onto his back with his body at or just behind the foot line, legs never sliding toward the camera. walk-NW dipped to 89 px in two stride frames for a fourth time (the back views N and NE dip to 90-91 as well): the dip is the knee bend in each step, so take 5 asks for short steps on almost straight legs. Take 6 (take 5 kept in /workspace/lk/troll-take5, with its precheck log and trial sheet troll5.png): walk-NW passes on short, straight-legged steps. death-S now falls across the frame and lies flat in time, 53 px tall. Its only failure is the dropped club: its head rolled 1 px past the limit, under the foot line (2 px wide at row 157 in the two lying frames, limit 156), while his body stays at or above 156. So the club lands flat beside his foot and never rolls toward the camera. Take 7 (take 6 kept in /workspace/lk/troll-take6, with precheck.txt and strip.png; take 5 restored as death-S.mp4, the closest take): take 6's club landed beside his foot but lay sideways across the frame, reaching the cell's right edge in 12 cells, rows 150..159 on the foot line, and 33 edge pixels off the 1 px outline. Take 5 is closer (only the club 1 px over the line), but it still fails an existing check. So take 7 drops the club behind his heels, away from the camera, where it cannot come below the foot line. Take 8 (take 7 kept in /workspace/lk/troll-take7, with precheck.log and strip.png; take 5 stays as death-S.mp4, the closest take): take 7 dropped the club in front of him again, lying across the frame. 3 cells touch the edge and the foot line reads 150..159. Every free drop in takes 5-7 landed the club in front of the line. So take 8 never lets go: the club falls with him and ends beside his body on the far side.

walk-NW.gait: Slow heavy ogre walk on the spot at his full standing height: back straight and upright, chest up, head raised level, never hunched forward, bent over or crouching. Short steps: his knees stay almost straight, each foot lifts only a little off the ground and sets down flat, and his standing leg never bends, so his head stays at exactly the same height in every frame, with no bob and no dip as he steps; big shoulders swaying, legs alternating clearly; his body never moves forward

death-S.death: roars and holds the exact first-frame pose still for a moment, never letting go of the club: he keeps it gripped in his left hand the whole time, so it falls with him and ends lying along his body on the far side of him, away from the camera, never in front of him, never across the frame and never reaching the edges of the image. He topples over sideways toward the image-left edge, his feet staying exactly where they stood, so he falls across the frame, neither toward nor away from the camera. He lands on his side and rolls onto his back, ending lying completely flat across the frame, his head on the ground at the image-left side and his feet where they stood, his whole body level with or a little behind the line his feet stood on, his arms on the ground, nothing raised, propped or sitting up, his legs never sliding toward the camera. He is lying flat before the middle of the clip and stays still for the whole last second. His body only ever moves down, never up. It never moves toward the camera: nothing, not his feet, his legs and not the club, comes lower in the frame than his feet were. He does not leap, spin, sit up or fall forward toward the camera; he lies where his feet were

death-W.death: roars and holds the exact first-frame pose still for a moment, then lets the club drop straight down beside his feet and topples over sideways, away from the camera, onto his far side, his feet staying exactly where they stood, so his whole body lies on the ground behind his feet, farther from the camera, the club lying close beside him. His body only ever moves down, never up. His feet never lift off the ground and nothing ever comes nearer the camera or lower in the frame than his feet were. He does not leap, kneel, spin or fall toward the camera; he lies where his feet were

death-E.death: roars and holds the exact first-frame pose still for a moment, then lets the club drop straight down beside his feet and topples over sideways, away from the camera, onto his far side, his feet staying exactly where they stood, so his whole body lies on the ground behind his feet, farther from the camera, the club lying close beside him. His body only ever moves down, never up. His feet never lift off the ground and nothing ever comes nearer the camera or lower in the frame than his feet were. He does not leap, kneel, spin or fall toward the camera; he lies where his feet were. His feet stay flat on the ground until his body is lying down, ending exactly in the pose of the last frame: lying on his side on the ground behind where his feet stood, the club beside him
